description: Per-Slurm-job GPU compute drill-down built from cgroup job attribution joined to DCGM. Formerly the DeepSeek board; workload name is not exported by any live collector, so runs are chosen by job ID.

options.content:
Training-run drill-down — GPU compute. Pick one or more Slurm jobs in Slurm job above; every panel is scoped to the GPUs inside those jobs. Note: the workload's name (DeepSeek, Nemotron, NeMo…) is not exported by anything currently scraping, so runs are selected by Slurm job ID rather than by model. Host CPU, memory and NVLink for the same job are on Run Drill-Down · Host & Memory and NCCL Runs.

panels.description: Distinct trays carrying a step of the selected job(s).
panels.title: Trays used by the selected run(s)

panels.description: GPUs on those trays that are reporting DCGM telemetry.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL[$__range]) and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: GPUs used by the selected run(s)

panels.description: Instantaneous sum of DCGM board power over the job's GPUs.

targets.expr: sum(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE[$__range]) and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Peak GPU power drawn by the selected run(s)

panels.description: Mean across every GPU in the selected job(s) of that GPU's peak SM utilisation over the window. The 'Mean util %' column of the table below breaks this down per tray; note the table is averaged per tray while this stat is averaged per GPU, so the two agree only when every tray contributes the same number of GPUs.

targets.expr: avg(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL[$__range]) and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Mean peak SM utilisation across the run's GPUs
Trays in the selected job(s) — the exact trays (footer Count = the tray stat; 'Mean util %' is the per-tray form of the utilisation stat)
GPU count and power by rack for the selected job(s) — these two columns sum to the two stats above
Compute health of the job's GPUs

panels.description: Allocated but idle — a stalled rank, a straggler, or a job that has not started stepping yet.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL[$__range]) == 0 and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Run GPUs that never left 0 % SM utilisation

targets.expr: max(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP[$__range]) and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Hottest GPU die reached in the selected run(s)

targets.expr: max(max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP[$__range]) and on(node) max by(node)(max_over_time(cgroup_info{username!="",username!="root",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Hottest HBM stack reached in the selected run(s)
